name: Susan Hall

summary.text: Susan Hall is a Unity Party candidate for U.S. House in Colorado's 7th District and a teacher by profession.

She was born in Denver, describes herself as a third-generation Coloradan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Metropolitan State University of Denver in 2003 after graduating from Lincoln High School.
This is at least her third run for the CD-7 seat; she also ran in 2012 and 2024.

experience.text: Previous candidate for U.S. House Colorado District 7 in 2012 and 2024.

positions.source_title: Susan Hall - Ballotpedia (2024 Candidate Connection survey)
positions.quote: The Billions of dollars saved from sending weapons abroad should go to support a healthy society which is gained through good jobs, education, healthcare, mental help provisions, affordable housing, & rehabilitation centers over punitive punishments with NO torture with US money.
positions.note: Inferred from a 2024 Candidate Connection survey answer about redirecting defense spending; she favors 'rehabilitation centers over punitive punishments' generally but does not address fentanyl penalties or Proposition 132 by name. Ballotpedia only gives the survey year, not an exact date.

research_notes: Hall has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey; the only survey content is from 2024, submitted for a prior run at the same seat. Her listed campaign website (susanhallforcongress.com, per Ballotpedia) no longer resolves (DNS failure on repeated attempts), and archive.org could not be reached for a cached snapshot (repeated 429 rate-limit responses during this session). She did not return the Denver Post's 2026 candidate questionnaire and has no Ballotpedia-listed endorsements. Most of her 2024 survey answers concern foreign policy (opposition to US military aid, calls for a Gaza ceasefire) and campaign finance, which do not map to any of the 25 statements; only the one inferred position above could be sourced. Reviewer should try to find a working campaign site or social media for current, race-specific statements if one surfaces before publication.
